title: Principal formal sections as an element of the adic completion
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least three [def-weil-pbc-depth], g in its maximal ideal, and W its punctured spectrum [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Put f:R to R/(g) and I=ker f. Each compatible family of sections of the open quotient-power thickenings [lem-sbc-finite-etale-adic-sections-transfer] is represented by a unique q in AdicCompletion I R [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Its level-n section is obtained by evaluating q in R/I^(n+1), identifying this ring with the global sections of its spectrum, and restricting along the second pullback projection. Completeness of R is not assumed.

proof.text: Depth at least three makes H^i_m(R) vanish for i=0,1,2 by 0AVY. The punctured-spectrum exact sequence 0BK0 gives H^1(W,O_W)=H^2_m(R)=0. The canonical degree-zero restriction R to Gamma(W,O_W) is bijective by depth-two puncture restriction.

Ann(g^n) stabilizes in the Noetherian ring R, so the kernels of g^n on O_W stabilize. Apply 0BLD, top exact row, with F=O_W and p=0. The right-hand term, the g-adic Tate module of H^1(W,O_W), is zero. Thus the ordinary completion of Gamma(W,O_W) maps isomorphically onto lim Gamma(W,O_W/g^n O_W). This source comparison is the input isolated here, independent of completeness of R.

Identify the source with AdicCompletion I R using the canonical degree-zero restriction bijection and I=(g). The second pullback projection realizes the open over W in Spec(R/I^(n+1)); pushforward of its structure sheaf is O_W/g^(n+1)O_W. Sections and the quotient transition maps are precisely the stated formal system. At level n+1 the comparison is evaluation followed by GammaSpecIso.inv and pullback.snd.appTop. Discarding index zero leaves the limit unchanged since R/I^0 is zero. The isomorphism yields the unique q.

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_principal_completion_comparison
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (g : R) (hg : g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := R) R)
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) :
    let f := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
    let I := RingHom.ker f
    ∀ s : ∀ n : ℕ, Γ(FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickening f W n, ⊤),
      (∀ n, (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningTransition f W n).appTop
        (s (n + 1)) = s n) →
      ∃! q : AdicCompletion I R, ∀ n,
        ((ΓSpecIso (.of (R ⧸ I ^ (n + 1)))).inv ≫
          (pullback.snd W.ι (FiniteEtale.Adic.baseMap f n)).appTop)
            (AdicCompletion.evalₐ I (n + 1) q) = s n
